The '''Zznza system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Yminis sector/Legends|Yminis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Outer Zznza|Zznza]].
